title: Baptism of the Holy Spirit
definition: Baptism of the Holy Spirit is the Spirit's work of uniting believers to Christ and incorporating them into His body.
summary: The Spirit brings believers into union with Christ and membership in His body.
christFocus: Jesus is the baptizer with the Holy Spirit, forming one people in Himself.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Baptism of the Holy Spirit refers to the Spirit's work in bringing believers into union with Christ and into the body of Christ. It is deeply connected to the saving work of Jesus and the formation of the Church.

At Pentecost, the promised Spirit was poured out, marking the new covenant age and empowering witness. The Spirit unites diverse believers into one body.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Confusion about Spirit baptism can create fear, pride, or division. This doctrine matters because the Spirit unites believers to Christ and one another.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Rest in your union with Christ and your place in His body. Seek fullness and obedience by the Spirit without despising other believers.
